title: Kissed Maharashtrian Chicken Stew
description: A smoky, tender stew that blends Maharashtrian spices, cider vinegar, and coconut milk for a kid-friendly keto-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tsp vegetable oil in a cazuela over medium heat until shimmering.
Add 1 chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in 2 minced garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Sprinkle 1 tsp garam masala and 1 tsp smoked paprika; toss to coat vegetables and let spice bloom for 30 seconds.
Add 200g diced chicken breast, 150g chopped tomatoes, and 1 tbsp cider vinegar; cook until chicken turns opaque, about 5–7 minutes.
Pour in 200ml coconut milk, reduce heat to low, and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes while stirring occasionally.
Stir in 2 tbsp peanut butter and pinch of salt & pepper; let mixture thicken, about 5 minutes.
Adjust seasoning with additional salt & pepper and a splash of vinegar if desired.
Transfer stew to serving bowls, garnish with fresh cilantro leaves and a drizzle of coconut cream if liked.
Serve hot with a side of cauliflower rice or low-carb flatbread for a complete keto-friendly meal.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
